output.summary: A root vegetable native to Southern Europe and the Near East, Spanish salsify forms a long, dark-skinned taproot with white flesh and sticky latex. Its roots, leafy shoots and open flowers can be eaten raw or cooked, though the thick root skin is usually considered inedible.
output.edibilityNote: Roots, leafy shoots and open flowers are eaten raw or cooked; the thick black root skin is usually considered inedible.
